Class PowerupIndicator

TextEntity
org.example.entities.powerups.PowerupIndicator
public class PowerupIndicator extends TextEntity
A brief visual indicator displayed when a powerup is triggered. Shows a symbol (★ or ♥) at the brick location for approximately 1.2 seconds.
